claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for the cached shell, go offline, navigate to edit and back

claim: Free to use with no account or checkout
where: landing facts, camera section, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; use the advertised record, print, and export flow without an account, checkout, or payment request

claim: Item cards, chosen supplier CSV rows, and item photos stay in this browser; no account or sync is needed
sandbox: fresh context; use a chosen supplier CSV to fill a card, save it with a photo while recording requests, hard-reload, and assert the saved CSV-derived fields and photo persist with no cross-origin request

claim: Manual barcode entry saves an item card
sandbox: fresh context; save a manual item and find it in /records

claim: Shows saved cards with the same barcode for review
sandbox: fresh /demo context; enter an existing sample barcode; assert the candidate and review link

claim: A chosen supplier CSV can fill matching item fields
sandbox: fresh context; upload an in-memory supplier CSV and match one barcode

claim: Exports every saved card as CSV
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download CSV; assert header and one row per sample card

claim: Searches saved cards by barcode, item, supplier, or location
sandbox: fresh /demo context; search each supported field and assert only its matching card remains

claim: Exports and imports a complete JSON backup
sandbox: fresh real-data context; save every field with a photo, export, delete, import, and compare all stored values

claim: Creates a printable one-up card with a barcode
sandbox: fresh /demo context; open the first print card; assert barcode marks and location

claim: Demo data never touches real cards
sandbox: fresh context; seed /demo then open /records and assert the sample cards are absent

claim: Sample cards can be searched, edited, and printed
sandbox: fresh /demo context; search, edit one sample card, save it, and print it

claim: Reset demo restores the samples, and Start for real clears demo changes without copying them to real cards
sandbox: fresh /demo context; edit a sample, reset it, edit again, start for real, and confirm no edit exists in real or reseeded demo cards

claim: Camera preview opens only after Scan with camera
where: landing, intake, camera page, and README
sandbox: fresh real-data context with a fake permitted camera; assert no camera dialog before the action, then open the preview from the action

claim: Camera scanning fills the barcode field
sandbox: fresh real-data context; replace the camera reader with a deterministic decoded-barcode fixture; assert the decoded value fills the barcode field and closes the scanner

claim: Large item photos are reduced to at most 1200 pixels on their longest side before storage
sandbox: fresh real-data context; choose a generated 1600 by 1000 PNG, save the card, reopen it, and assert the stored JPEG is 1200 by 750

claim: Entering a barcode does not trigger an automatic web lookup
sandbox: fresh real-data context; record every request after entering an unknown barcode and assert that no request occurs and no item details are filled

claim: Saving an item card does not create a purchase order
sandbox: fresh real-data context; save a card while recording mutating requests, export its JSON backup, and assert no purchase-order data or network mutation exists
